parameters.name: functionName
parameters.description: The function name. If you leave this parameter empty, the concurrency configurations of all functions are returned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries returned.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc list-concurrency-configs --function-name my-func --next-token MTIzNCNhYmM= --limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
